decision.summary: A broad elevated platform in U (695–710) lacks a clean opposing return; the preceding spike at 692 and weak co-occurring E dip do not form a closed temporary offset. No confirmed temporary interval exists due to ambiguous return behavior.

intervals.observation: U shows a sustained elevation (+2 to +4 MAD) from ~695 to 710, preceded by a sharp upward spike at 692; E exhibits a weak dip (~−1 MAD) around 698–705 but no clear opposing return in either axis. Return phase is ambiguous and incomplete within allowed context.
